_comment: Generated by tikz2html --init. Check the values below, in particular other_tex_files and tikz_macros; see the README of tikz2html for all the options.
_comment_files: The tex files of the document, without .tex (found by following \input, \include, \subfile and \import). Add new files here.
_comment_macros: Macros that draw TikZ pictures, with their arguments: m = mandatory, o = optional [...], s = star, "" = no arguments. Every equation that uses one becomes an svg.
_comment_options: A single html page. For one page per section use "mathml,mathjax,next,3" (sections are level 3 in tex4ht's numbering).
